safety: Propose-first. Eval runs must STOP at the triage table — never implement, commit, or push. Subagent instructions enforce this.

evals.prompt: can you pull the comments for PR <PR_NUMBER> and propose how to address them?
evals.expected_output: Fetches review threads via gh api (without being pasted them), groups into threads, skips resolved/already-answered, fact-checks each against the code, and presents a triage table + draft replies + fix plan. Stops there.

evals.prompt: look at the baz comments on PR <PR_NUMBER> and resolve them for me
evals.expected_output: Recognizes baz as the AI reviewer, pulls its comments, fact-checks (including declining low-severity nits with rationale), and STILL shows the triage table before any action. Does not push.
